title: Static equilibrium of the charged $N$-body problem
summary: We study non-collision static equilibria in the charged \(N\)-body problem. Unlike the classical Newtonian case, such equilibria may exist because the effective interaction coefficients $δ_{ij}=m_im_j-e_ie_j$ can be positive, negative, or zero. We give a complete classification of three-body equilibria and prove that all of them are collinear and linearly unstable.
